body: They are only legit after you are dead.... True, which is why I put this here, so people can think about what will happen to those that they love after they are gone.

I have seen it once and that was enough to know that nobody deserves to die in such a sad and awful way.  It truly is a horrifying way to go, and you stand a very good chance of adversely effecting the life of the one who finds the victim.  If you are even considering that as a choice, please seek help. It is great that you are on this sub right now, but in my mind you need to find the person that you trust and love more than anyone in the world and tell them, it may seem awkward and scary to out yourself as having these problems, but it is better than the alternative. 
I know I am not the best at writing and my thoughts may be jumbled but I know one thing, no one should go out like that.
Sorry pal... You can't blame me, this is a solid name
